text:
Ravi: Heads-up: finance pinged about inflated quota for proj-beta; traces show some SA impersonation tokens missing project claim.
Nina: Saw similar during yesterday's mint-service rollout. The fallback path strips project_id in some code paths.
Omar: Can you paste a redacted trace?
Ravi: trace t-77: incoming assertion has project_id=proj-beta, minted token has no project_id.
Claire: If minted tokens lack project_id, routers mark them projectless and dashboards double-count. Short-term: mint-service should copy incoming project_id into `X-Attrib-Project` header on the response.
Nina: I'll add a small canary flag `authz.attribution.preserve=true` and a metric `authz.attribution.missing` to monitor.
deploy-bot: Deployed: mint-service v2.9.1-canary by CI (03:02 UTC) :white_check_mark:
Omar: Also recommend an audit event when a claim is dropped so we can run a backfill and reconcile billing.
Claire: UX: add a tooltip in quotas UI explaining "Attribution source" and show if values were backfilled.
Ravi: Plan: Nina will push patch + canary, Omar will prepare backfill job, Claire updates dashboard docs. Ping here when canary live. :thumbsup:
